name: Sina De La Ville
positioning: One of Milan's historic hotels, in the heart of the city between the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele, the Duomo and La Scala
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to the Duomo, the Galleria and La Scala
Opera lovers planning an evening at Teatro alla Scala
Guests who like a sauna and a deck with cathedral views after a day in the city

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Milan, between the Vittorio Emanuele Gallery, the Cathedral and the La Scala Opera House.
Sina De La Ville is one of Milan's historic hotels.
The hotel is at Via Hoepli 6 in Milan.
Nearby are the Duomo, Teatro della Scala and Via Montenapoleone.
Guests can choose between rooms with classical or contemporary decor.
The classical rooms have wall fabrics and parquet floors.
The contemporary rooms have showers or bathtubs.
The Wellness Center has a Finnish sauna, a steam bath, a fitness area and an emotional shower.
The cuisine at Il Vizio restaurant focuses on traditional Mediterranean recipes enriched with a fusion touch.
Three modernly equipped rooms with natural light are available for meetings and conferences.

highlights.text: On the 5th floor there is a wet deck with a roof that opens.
The 5th-floor wet deck has views of Milan's cathedral.
The hotel is just steps away from the Duomo and the Vittorio Emanuele II Gallery.
The hotel offers an Opera Package to experience Teatro alla Scala.

considerations.text: Rooms come in classical or contemporary decor, and the contemporary rooms have either a shower or a bathtub, so ask which you are booking.
WhataHotel notes limited parking availability in the busy city center location.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.

sources.title: Sina De La Ville, Milan (official site)
